item.title: Mon 17 Aug — Unnatural calm: records vs a bond bear market
item.description: Wall St eases from records with the VIX at 14.25 while long bonds sell off; Fed and RBA lean hawkish; ASX opens soft into a heavy earnings week (JB Hi-Fi -12%, NAB); oil firms on Iran.
